recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the onion (and pepper) and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and ½ tsp salt. Simmer 10 minutes, crushing the tomatoes, until thick.
Make 4 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook on low for 6 minutes, until the whites are set but the yolks are soft.
Scatter over the feta and parsley and serve straight from the pan with bread.
recipes.tip: If the sauce gets too thick before the eggs go in, add a splash of water.

recipes.name: Hummus
extra: a pinch of paprika, to finish
steps: Put the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and ½ tsp salt in the blender.
Blend for 1 minute, adding 3–4 tbsp of the chickpea liquid or cold water, until very smooth.
Taste and add more lemon or salt if needed.
Spread in a bowl, make a swirl with a spoon, drizzle with oil and sprinkle with paprika and parsley.
recipes.tip: For extra smooth hummus, blend for a full 3 minutes and use ice-cold water.

recipes.name: Lentil soup (Shorbat adas)
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pot. Cook the onion, carrot (and potato) for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and turmeric and stir for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, 5 cups water and the stock cube. Bring to the boil, then simmer 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.
Blend until smooth, or whisk hard if you have no blender. Add salt to taste.
Serve with lemon wedges and toasted bread.
recipes.tip: Thick soup? Add hot water a little at a time.
recipes.pressure: Fry the onion, carrot, garlic and spices in the pot. Add the lentils, potato, stock cube and 5 cups water. Cook 8 minutes at high pressure, let the pressure drop by itself (about 10 minutes), then blend. Never fill the pot more than half full.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma wraps
need: 500 g chicken thighs or breast, in strips
extra: 3 tbsp tahini or mayonnaise, for the sauce
steps: Mix the yogurt, 2 cloves of the garlic, the juice of half the lemon, the spices, 1 tbsp oil and ½ tsp salt. Stir in the chicken and leave 10 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Cook the chicken: in a hot pan with a little oil for 8 minutes, turning, until charred at the edges. Air fryer: 200°C for 12 minutes, shaking halfway. Oven: 220°C for 20 minutes.
For the sauce, mix the tahini or mayo with the last clove of garlic, the rest of the lemon juice and a little water.
Warm the bread, spread with sauce, add the chicken and vegetables, and roll up tightly.
recipes.tip: Thighs stay juicier than breast.

recipes.name: Kofta skewers
need: 500 g minced beef or minced lamb
a big handful of parsley, finely chopped
steps: Squeeze the grated onion to drain its juice. Mix it with the meat, parsley, spices and 1 tsp salt. Knead for 2 minutes.
Shape into 12 fingers with wet hands.
Cook: in a hot oiled pan for 8 minutes, turning often. Air fryer: 200°C for 10 minutes. Oven: 220°C for 15 minutes.
Serve in warm bread with yogurt and cucumber.
recipes.tip: Chill the shaped kofta 15 minutes if they feel soft; they hold together better.

recipes.name: Mujaddara (lentils and rice)
extra: a salad of cucumber or tomato, to serve
steps: Cover the lentils with water and boil for 15 minutes until almost tender. Drain.
Meanwhile fry the onions in 4 tbsp oil over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring, until deep brown. Lift out half for the top.
Add the rice and cumin to the pot with the rest of the onions and stir 1 minute.
Add the lentils, 2 cups water and 1 tsp salt. Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat, fluff with a fork and top with the crispy onions.
recipes.tip: Don't rush the onions: their dark colour is the flavour of the dish. Red lentils go mushy here.
recipes.pressure: Cook the brown or green lentils in 3 cups water for 8 minutes at high pressure instead of boiling them for 15. Release the pressure, drain, and carry on from step 3.

recipes.name: Fattoush salad
steps: Toss the bread pieces with 1 tbsp oil. Toast in a pan for 5 minutes, or air fry at 180°C for 5 minutes, until crisp.
Put all the vegetables and herbs in a big bowl.
Whisk the lemon juice, 4 tbsp oil, sumac, pomegranate molasses and ½ tsp salt.
Just before eating, toss everything with the dressing and the crisp bread.
recipes.tip: Add the bread at the last minute so it stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Foul medames
steps: Warm the beans with their liquid in a small pot for 5 minutes.
Mash about half of them with a fork.
Stir in the garlic, lemon juice, cumin, ½ tsp salt and 2 tbsp oil.
Top with tomato, parsley and chili and serve hot with bread.
recipes.tip: A spoon of tahini makes it creamier.

recipes.name: Chicken machboos
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a big pot and fry the onions 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, baharat, turmeric, cinnamon and cardamom and stir 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes, dried limes (pierced) or lemon, 1½ tsp salt and 4 cups water. Simmer covered for 30 minutes.
Lift out the chicken. Measure the broth: you need 3 cups (top up with water). Add the drained rice to the broth.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile brown the chicken under the oven grill or in the air fryer at 200°C for 8 minutes. Serve on top of the rice with coriander and raisins.
recipes.tip: Dried limes (loomi) give the real Gulf taste.
recipes.pressure: After browning the chicken (step 3), add the tomatoes, limes, salt and 3½ cups water and cook 10 minutes at high pressure instead of simmering for 30. Release the pressure, then carry on from step 4.

recipes.name: Batata harra (spicy potatoes)
need: a big handful of coriander, chopped
steps: Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and ½ tsp salt.
Cook until golden: air fryer 200°C for 18 minutes, shaking twice; or oven 220°C for 30 minutes; or shallow-fry in a pan for 15 minutes.
In a pan, warm 2 tbsp oil and fry the garlic, chili and paprika for 1 minute.
Toss the hot potatoes in the garlic oil with the coriander and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.tip: Dry the potato cubes well before oiling; they crisp better.

recipes.name: Masoor dal
need: 2 tomatoes or ½ can chopped tomatoes
steps: Boil the lentils with 3 cups water and the turmeric. Simmer 20 minutes until soft, skimming off any foam.
Meanwhile heat 2 tbsp oil and fry the onion 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, chili and cumin and stir 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Stir the onion mix into the lentils with 1 tsp salt and simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander. Serve with rice.
recipes.tip: Ghee instead of oil in the frying step gives a richer dal.
recipes.pressure: Fry the onion, garlic, ginger, chili and cumin in the pot first. Add the tomatoes, the rinsed lentils, turmeric, 1 tsp salt and 2½ cups water. Lock the lid and cook 6 minutes at high pressure, then let the pressure drop by itself (about 10 minutes). Stir well and finish with lemon and coriander. Lentils foam, so never fill the pot more than half full.

recipes.name: Chicken curry
need: 2 tomatoes or ½ can chopped tomatoes
2 tsp garam masala or curry powder
extra: ½ cup yogurt or coconut milk
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil and fry the onions 10 minutes until golden brown.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili and cook 1 minute. Add the spices and stir 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt. Cook 5 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the chicken and stir to coat. Add ½ cup water, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt or coconut milk and heat gently for 2 minutes without boiling. Top with coriander.
recipes.tip: Take the pan off the heat before adding yogurt so it doesn't split.
recipes.pressure: Make the onion and tomato base in the pot (steps 1–3). Add the chicken and only ¼ cup water. Cook 8 minutes at high pressure, then release the pressure carefully. Stir in the yogurt or coconut milk with the heat off.

recipes.name: Chana masala
need: 2 tsp garam masala or curry powder
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil, add the cumin for 20 seconds, then fry the onions 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute, then the spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt and cook 5 minutes into a thick sauce.
Add the chickpeas and 1 cup water. Simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
recipes.pressure: Using dried chickpeas instead of cans? Soak 1½ cups overnight, then cook them in plenty of water with 1 tsp salt for 15 minutes at high pressure and let the pressure drop by itself. Use them in step 4.

recipes.name: Aloo matar (potato and peas)
need: 1 tsp garam masala or curry powder
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil, add the cumin for 20 seconds, then the onion for 6 minutes.
Add the ginger, garlic and chili for 1 minute, then the turmeric and garam masala.
Add the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt and cook 4 minutes.
Add the potatoes and 1½ cups water. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Add the peas for the last 5 minutes. Top with coriander.
recipes.pressure: Make the base in the pot (steps 1–3), then add the potatoes and only ¾ cup water. Cook 3 minutes at high pressure, release the pressure quickly, stir in the peas and cook 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Egg curry (anda curry)
need: 2 tomatoes or ½ can chopped tomatoes
1 tsp garam masala or curry powder
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel. Make a few small cuts in each.
Heat 3 tbsp oil and fry the onions 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute, then the spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt and cook 5 minutes. Add 1 cup water and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the eggs and simmer 5 minutes, spooning the sauce over them. Top with coriander.
recipes.tip: Frying the peeled eggs for 2 minutes first gives them a golden skin that holds the sauce.
recipes.pressure: Boil the eggs in the pressure cooker: 1 cup water, eggs on the rack, 5 minutes at high pressure, 5 minutes letting the pressure drop, then straight into cold water. They peel easily.

recipes.name: Keema matar
need: 500 g minced beef or minced lamb
2 tsp garam masala or curry powder
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil and fry the onions 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute.
Add the mince and cook 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the spices, tomatoes, yogurt and 1 tsp salt. Cook 5 minutes, then add ½ cup water, cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the peas and cook 5 minutes more. Top with coriander.
recipes.pressure: Brown the onions, garlic, ginger and mince in the pot (steps 1–3). Add the spices, tomatoes, yogurt, salt and ¼ cup water. Cook 6 minutes at high pressure, release the pressure, then stir in the peas and simmer 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken biryani
extra: a pinch of saffron in 3 tbsp warm milk
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, garlic, ginger, garam masala, chili, turmeric and 1½ tsp salt. Leave 20 minutes.
Fry the onions in 4 tbsp oil for 15 minutes until deep brown. Take out half for the top.
Add the chicken and tomatoes to the pot and cook 20 minutes until the chicken is done and the sauce is thick.
Meanwhile boil the drained rice in plenty of salted water with the cardamom, cinnamon and bay leaves for 6 minutes, until three-quarters cooked. Drain.
Spread the rice over the chicken. Top with the fried onions, herbs, saffron milk and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes. Rest 5 minutes, then mix gently from the bottom as you serve.
recipes.tip: Wrap the lid in a tea towel so no steam escapes.

recipes.name: Vegetable pulao
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil or ghee. Add the cumin, cardamom, cinnamon and bay leaves for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook 6 minutes until golden.
Add the vegetables and garam masala and stir 2 minutes.
Add the drained rice, 2¼ cups water and 1 tsp salt. Boil, then cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat and fluff with a fork.
recipes.pressure: Do steps 1–3 in the pot, then add the drained rice, salt and only 1¾ cups water (pressure cookers need less). Cook 4 minutes at high pressure, let the pressure drop by itself for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.name: Masala omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with all the other ingredients and a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat and pour in the eggs.
Cook 2 minutes until the bottom sets, then fold or flip and cook 1 minute more.
Serve hot with bread.

recipes.name: Bhindi masala (okra)
steps: Wash the okra and dry it completely before slicing.
Fry the okra in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, uncovered, until no longer sticky. Set aside.
In the same pan fry the onion 5 minutes, then add the spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and ½ tsp salt and cook 4 minutes.
Return the okra and cook 3 minutes. Finish with lemon juice.
recipes.tip: Never cover okra while it cooks, or it turns slimy.

recipes.name: Tomato and garlic pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water as the packet says, usually 10 minutes.
Meanwhile warm 3 tbsp oil and cook the onion 4 minutes, then the garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and ½ tsp salt. Simmer 10 minutes. Add a pinch of sugar if it tastes sharp.
Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water. Toss the pasta in the sauce with a splash of the water.
Serve with basil and cheese.

recipes.name: Garlic and chili spaghetti
steps: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water as the packet says.
Meanwhile warm 5 tbsp oil on low heat with the garlic and chili for 4 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold. Don't let it brown.
Keep ½ cup of pasta water, then drain.
Toss the spaghetti in the garlic oil with a splash of pasta water for 1 minute until glossy.
Add parsley, a squeeze of lemon and cheese.
recipes.tip: Burnt garlic tastes bitter. Start again if it goes dark brown.

recipes.name: Creamy mushroom pasta
extra: a handful of parmesan or cheese
steps: Boil the pasta as the packet says.
Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil and the butter over high heat for 6 minutes until browned. Add the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
If using milk, stir in the flour for 1 minute first. Pour in the cream or milk and simmer 3 minutes until thick.
Add the cheese, salt and pepper, then toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water.
Top with parsley.
recipes.tip: Don't crowd the mushrooms: they brown instead of steaming.

recipes.name: Stovetop mac and cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni 1 minute less than the packet says, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pot, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk a little at a time. Simmer 4 minutes, stirring, until it thickens.
Off the heat, stir in the cheese, mustard and salt until smooth.
Stir in the macaroni. Optional: top with breadcrumbs and air fry at 190°C for 5 minutes for a crunchy top.

recipes.name: Spanish potato omelette
steps: Cook the potatoes and onion slowly in ½ cup oil in a frying pan for 15 minutes, until soft but not crisp. Drain off the oil.
Beat the eggs with 1 tsp salt. Stir in the potatoes and leave 5 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in the pan, pour in the mix and cook on low for 8 minutes until almost set.
Put a plate over the pan, flip the omelette onto it and slide it back in. Cook 3 minutes more.
Serve warm or cold, in wedges.

recipes.name: Fluffy pancakes
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg and melted butter, pour into the flour and stir until just mixed. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a pan over medium heat with a little oil. Pour in ¼ cup of batter per pancake.
Flip when bubbles appear on top, about 2 minutes, and cook 1 minute more.
Serve with honey and banana.
recipes.tip: Don't over-mix the batter, or the pancakes come out flat.

recipes.name: French toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar and cinnamon in a wide dish.
Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Dip each slice in the egg for a few seconds on each side.
Fry 2 minutes per side until golden. Serve with honey and fruit.
recipes.tip: Day-old bread soaks better without falling apart.

recipes.name: Lemon chicken and potatoes
need: 6 chicken thighs or 800 g chicken pieces
steps: Mix 3 tbsp oil, the lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, paprika and 1½ tsp salt.
Toss the chicken, potatoes and onion in it.
Oven: spread on a tray and roast at 210°C for 45 minutes, turning once, until golden. Air fryer: cook the potatoes at 200°C for 10 minutes, add the chicken and cook 20 minutes more, shaking halfway.
Check the chicken is cooked through (no pink near the bone), then serve with the pan juices.
recipes.tip: Put the squeezed lemon halves on the tray too for more flavour.

recipes.name: Beef burgers
steps: Mix the beef, onion, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Shape 4 patties a little wider than the buns and press a dent in the middle.
Cook in a hot oiled pan for 4 minutes per side. Air fryer: 200°C for 10 minutes, turning halfway.
Add the cheese for the last minute and cover to melt.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with salad and sauces.
recipes.tip: Only flip once and don't press the patties; they stay juicy.

recipes.name: Lemon garlic fish
steps: Mix the garlic, butter or 1 tbsp oil, half the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Brush it over the fish.
Oven: bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes. Air fryer: 190°C for 9 minutes. The fish is done when it flakes easily.
Squeeze over the rest of the lemon and add parsley.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice
steps: No cooked rice? Cook 1 cup rice, spread it on a plate and cool it for 20 minutes first.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or big pan over high heat. Fry the garlic, onion and vegetables (and chicken or prawns) for 3 minutes.
Push to one side, crack in the eggs and scramble for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir-fry 3 minutes until hot. Add the soy sauce and sesame oil and toss well.
recipes.tip: Cold rice fries; fresh hot rice turns sticky.

recipes.name: Chicken stir-fry
need: 2 bell peppers or broccoli or carrots
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, cornflour and 3 tbsp water for the sauce.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high heat. Stir-fry the chicken 5 minutes until cooked. Take it out.
Stir-fry the vegetables, garlic and ginger 3 minutes; they should stay crunchy.
Return the chicken, add the sauce and toss 1 minute until glossy. Top with spring onions.
recipes.tip: Cut everything before you start: stir-frying is fast.

recipes.name: Garlic soy noodles
extra: a handful of cabbage or spinach
steps: Cook the noodles as the packet says and drain.
Warm 2 tbsp oil and fry the garlic and chili for 1 minute. Add the greens for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil. Toss 1 minute.
Top with spring onions and a fried egg.

recipes.name: Peanut noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the packet says. Keep ½ cup of the water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, garlic, honey, lime juice and chili with 4 tbsp hot noodle water until smooth.
Toss the drained noodles in the sauce.
Top with cucumber, carrot and spring onions. Eat warm or cold.

recipes.name: Honey soy chicken
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, cornflour and 3 tbsp water.
Pan: fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden. Air fryer: 200°C for 12 minutes, then put it in a pan.
Pour the sauce over and bubble 2 minutes until sticky.
Top with sesame seeds and spring onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Thai-style coconut chicken curry
need: 2 tbsp curry paste or curry powder
extra: a handful of basil or coriander
steps: Fry the onion in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry paste and stir 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, ½ cup water, the sugar and 1 tsp salt. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pepper for the last 5 minutes. Finish with lime juice and herbs.

recipes.name: Chili garlic prawns
steps: Dry the prawns with kitchen paper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil and the butter. Fry the garlic and chili for 30 seconds.
Add the prawns and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Add the soy sauce and honey and toss 30 seconds. Finish with lemon and spring onions.
recipes.tip: Prawns turn rubbery fast: take them off as soon as they curl and turn pink.

recipes.name: Nasi goreng
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and chili in 2 tbsp oil for 3 minutes (add chicken or prawns now if using, and cook through).
Add the rice and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, ketchup and sugar and toss until the rice is evenly coloured.
Fry the eggs separately and put one on each plate of rice, with cucumber and tomato on the side.

recipes.name: Chicken adobo
steps: Put the chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, pepper and ½ cup water in a pot.
Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and brown it in a hot oiled pan for 3 minutes per side.
Boil the sauce 5 minutes to reduce, add the sugar, and pour it over the chicken. Serve with rice.
recipes.tip: Don't stir for the first few minutes after the vinegar goes in; it cooks off more gently.
recipes.pressure: Put the chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves and pepper in the pot with only ¼ cup water. Cook 10 minutes at high pressure and let the pressure drop by itself for 5 minutes. Then brown the chicken and reduce the sauce (steps 3–4).

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken
steps: Toss the chicken in beaten egg (if using), then in 2 tbsp of the cornflour with a pinch of salt.
Fry in 3 tbsp oil for 7 minutes until golden and cooked. Air fryer: spray with oil, 200°C for 12 minutes.
Mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, the last 1 tbsp cornflour and ½ cup water.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion and garlic 3 minutes. Pour in the sauce and bubble 1 minute until thick.
Toss in the chicken and serve straight away with rice.

recipes.name: Harees
need: 2 cups harees wheat (whole wheat grains), soaked overnight
500 g lamb or chicken on the bone
steps: Drain the soaked wheat and put it in a big pot with the meat, 8 cups water and 1½ tsp salt.
Bring to the boil and skim off the foam.
Cover and simmer on low for 2½ hours, stirring every 20 minutes so it doesn't stick. Add hot water if it gets too thick.
Lift out the meat, remove the bones, shred it and return it to the pot.
Beat hard with a wooden spoon for 5 minutes (or a few short pulses with a hand blender) until smooth and stretchy.
Serve hot with melted ghee poured on top and a pinch of cinnamon.
recipes.pressure: Put the soaked wheat, meat, salt and 6 cups water in the pot. Cook 45 minutes at high pressure and let the pressure drop by itself. Remove the bones, then beat until smooth and stretchy.
recipes.tip: Harees should be thick, smooth and slightly stretchy, like a porridge you can hold on a spoon.

recipes.name: Luqaimat (sweet dumplings)
need: date syrup or honey, to drizzle
steps: Mix the flour, cornflour, yeast, sugar, cardamom, saffron and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the warm water a little at a time to make a thick, sticky batter, like very thick pancake batter.
Cover and leave in a warm place for 40 minutes until bubbly and doubled.
Heat oil about 5 cm deep over medium heat. A drop of batter should sizzle and rise slowly.
Drop small balls of batter into the oil using two teaspoons dipped in water. Fry 5 minutes, turning, until golden all over.
Drain on paper, drizzle with date syrup and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Eat warm.
recipes.tip: If the oil is too hot they brown outside but stay raw inside. Fry a test one first.

recipes.name: Balaleet (sweet vermicelli with eggs)
extra: a pinch of saffron in 2 tbsp warm water
steps: Toast the vermicelli in the ghee or 1 tbsp oil over medium heat for 3 minutes until golden.
Add 2 cups water, the sugar, cardamom, saffron water and rose water. Simmer 8 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Cover and leave on the lowest heat for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and cook a thin omelette in a little oil.
Serve the vermicelli with the omelette on top.
recipes.tip: A classic Emirati breakfast: sweet and salty together.

recipes.name: Chicken saloona
steps: Fry the onions in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, baharat and turmeric and stir 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and tomato paste and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Add the potatoes, carrots, dried lime, 4 cups water and 1½ tsp salt. Cover and simmer 25 minutes, adding the zucchini for the last 10 minutes.
Top with coriander and serve with rice.
recipes.pressure: After step 4, add the potatoes, carrots, dried lime, salt and 2½ cups water. Cook 8 minutes at high pressure, release the pressure, add the zucchini and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Thareed (meat stew over bread)
steps: Fry the onions in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes. Add the baharat and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the meat and brown 5 minutes, then the tomatoes for 5 minutes.
Add 5 cups water, 1½ tsp salt and the dried lime. Simmer covered: lamb 50 minutes, chicken 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots for 20 minutes, and the zucchini for the last 10 minutes.
Tear the bread into a deep serving dish in layers and ladle over enough broth to soak it.
Arrange the meat and vegetables on top and serve straight away.
recipes.pressure: For lamb: after browning, add the water, salt and dried lime and cook 25 minutes at high pressure. Release, add the vegetables and simmer 15 minutes.
recipes.tip: A favourite at Ramadan iftar.

recipes.name: Chebab (Emirati pancakes)
steps: Whisk the flour, yeast, sugar, cardamom, saffron and a pinch of salt.
Whisk in the egg and warm milk until smooth, like thick pancake batter.
Cover and leave 30 minutes until bubbly.
Heat a pan over medium-low heat and wipe with a little butter. Pour in a small ladle of batter.
Cook 2 minutes until bubbles cover the top, flip and cook 1 minute more.
Serve warm with date syrup and cream cheese.

recipes.name: Dango (spiced chickpeas)
steps: Warm the chickpeas with ½ cup water and ½ tsp salt for 5 minutes.
Drain well.
Toss with the cumin, chili powder, ½ tsp black pepper and the lemon juice.
Add the green chili and coriander and serve warm in small cups.
recipes.tip: A popular snack for Ramadan and Eid gatherings.

recipes.name: Karak chai
need: 2 tea bags or 2 tsp black tea
steps: Boil 1½ cups water with the cardamom (and ginger) for 3 minutes.
Add the tea and sugar and boil 3 minutes until very dark.
Pour in the milk and bring it up to the boil, then lower the heat as it rises. Do this three times, about 3 minutes.
Strain into cups and serve hot.
recipes.tip: Letting it rise three times is what makes karak thick and strong.

recipes.name: Samak mashwi (Gulf grilled fish)
need: 2 fish fillets or 1 whole fish (hammour, kingfish or sea bream)
steps: Mix the garlic, spices, juice of half the lemon, 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt into a paste.
Rub it all over the fish (make a few slits first if it's whole). Leave 10 minutes.
Cook: air fryer 200°C for 12 minutes; oven at 220°C for 15 minutes (whole fish 25 minutes); or in a hot oiled pan 4 minutes per side.
Squeeze over the rest of the lemon, add coriander and serve with rice.
recipes.tip: The fish is done when it flakes easily at the thickest part.

recipes.name: Margoogat (stew with thin dough)
steps: For the dough, mix the flour with ½ tsp salt and about ⅓ cup water. Knead 3 minutes until smooth, cover and rest 15 minutes.
Fry the onions in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes, add the spices for 1 minute, then the chicken for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes for 5 minutes, then 4 cups water, 1½ tsp salt and the dried lime. Simmer 20 minutes.
Add the vegetables and simmer 10 minutes.
Roll the dough very thin, cut it into 5 cm squares and drop them into the simmering stew one by one. Cook 10 minutes until tender.
Rest 5 minutes, top with coriander and serve.
recipes.tip: Roll the dough as thin as you can: it thickens the stew as it cooks.
